messages.text: The API Gateway is taking too long to configure for the supplier endpoints, I'm connecting directly to the DB for now as a temporary workaround so we aren't blocked.
Sprint review tomorrow, please update your stories in Jira.
Reminder: all integrations must go through API Gateway as per ADR-001. No exceptions.

meetings.title: Atlas Sprint Review
decisions: Approved: API Gateway as only integration method
meetings.transcript_excerpt: We discussed the integration challenges. It was confirmed that the API Gateway is the only approved method. Developer 01 will resolve the authentication bug.

meetings.title: Atlas Architecture Review
meetings.transcript_excerpt: Reviewed current architecture state and agreed to postpone go-live to Q4.
